author: Rinehart
text:
My background is that I've been trading for 5 or 6 years now. I've
spent enough time in front of the screen that I'm slightly more
profitable than not. However, I haven't been able to reach my dream of
trading full time for a living. I've tried many different methods and
paid for education from various sources. Some of what I have learned
was worthwhile most was not.

As I've been going over the material, I've had many A-Ha moments. Fact
is this is the only material I've found that works on all time frames
from the 1 min to the monthly. That alone tells me this material gives a
 deeper understanding of the mechanics of the market. Also the fact
trades can be planned in advance, entered with limit orders, and risk
controlled is fantastic. I will admit I am very sad I didn't find this
material sooner and I'm jealous of anyone that joins RTM brand new, lol!

I'm looking forward to my journey here at RTM. I believe I am finally
where I need to be to bring enough pieces together to hopefully take the
 next step!

Rinehart
